claim_text: Both insufficient and excessive iodine intake can alter thyroid function; people with known thyroid disease should not be assumed to need iodine supplements without assessment of dietary exposure, diagnosis and medication context.
health_goal_or_outcome: Support safe, evidence-based nutrient assessment and avoid unsupported or unnecessary supplementation.

population.other_context: People with thyroid disease or thyroid-active medicines.

ingredient_form_or_preparation: Dietary and supplemental sources; verify exact product form and label.
evidence_summary: NIH ODS Iodine Health Professional Fact Sheet summarizes deficiency, excess and medication interactions.
limitations: Thyroid disorders differ; no diagnosis or dose can be inferred from this general claim.
Exact source passages and underlying evidence require full appraisal before approval.
